scope: Fresh verification: 42 editor checks, 6 media-editing checks, 7 capture-control checks and 4 encoded composition checks. Copy/paste, live multitrack Move with Cancel/Done, Placement, audio file import, saved recording marks and circular inset movement/resizing pass in portrait and landscape. Encoded circular masks and swaps pass at 0/90/180/270 degrees. Other suites retain earlier timestamps. Installed on the connected phone.

manual_build.note: Same 24 default device checks, run on the separate manual build; excluded from the unique total.
manual_build.scope: Earlier checkpoint, before the current camera/editor UI corrections.

source_export.runtime_and_model_preparation: Verified with production manifests, outside the excluded folders.
source_export.scope: Earlier repository snapshot, before the recording orientation normalizer.

timeline_regression.before_fix: A small drag left 98 of 252 sampled thumbnail pixels stationary or incorrectly positioned.
timeline_regression.after_fix: Rendered thumbnail pixels translate together through split boundaries in portrait and landscape.
timeline_regression.user_project: The saved outlet project is byte-for-byte unchanged.

camera_pixel_comparison.reference: Raw ImageReader sensor pixels rotated once; front references use the mirrored selfie view. Crop and optical-center alignment are allowed; no original footage is published.
camera_pixel_comparison.note: Fresh checks include front/rear camera switches while retaining the mirrored front view.

model_provenance_audit.scope: Installed ONNX learned parameter values match the public upstream v2 checkpoint. This is not a comparison with packaged iOS model weights or iOS waveform processing.

registered_scene_check.scope: Standard-primaries interpretation inferred from registered SDR/HLG scenes. The camera tone curves and exposure can still differ; not a color-chart certification.

concurrent_camera_test.scope: Attached-device concurrent configuration accepted and actual recordings passed; other devices negotiate supported combinations.

transition_icon.reference: Recent iOS editor screenshot supplied by the user
transition_icon.manual_check: Two transition markers rendered between three clips on the connected device. Checked border, inward triangles, size and dark fill.

recent_references.projects: Import, local privacy policy, Recently deleted with restore and permanent removal, smaller menu dots and revised card spacing.
recent_references.effects: Two-way mirror default, four-way mirrored grid, denser angular patterns, reflected edges and RGB Offset.
recent_references.editor: Larger effect/transition buttons with horizontal scrolling; manually verified that the transition panel opens after scrolling.
recent_references.screenshots: Synthetic media and subject-pattern checks; user projects were not edited.

kaleidoscope_center.before: Regression reproduced: Center changed source sampling while the mirror junction stayed at the viewport center.
kaleidoscope_center.after: Center X/Y position the output junction. Default position is 50% / 50%, with the preceding source framing retained.
kaleidoscope_center.scope: Synthetic subject and coordinate-pattern checks on Android; exact iOS shader parity is not established.

selfie_alignment.recording: Front input is mirrored in displayed coordinates, including the recording rotation hint; rear input remains normal.
selfie_alignment.legacy_correction: Optional .mirror source metadata is applied before creative effects, timeline thumbnails and project thumbnails.
selfie_alignment.first_orientation_attempt: One moving-person sample missed the fixed correlation margin; an unchanged rerun passed all five checks.
selfie_alignment.composition_shutdown: Detach the compositor encoder tick before MediaRecorder disconnects its surface.

live_rotation.activity_policy: FULL_USER follows Android rotation settings; recording no longer imposes a portrait/landscape lock.
live_rotation.encoder: Display changes update camera correction during capture. The original encoded frame size stays fixed; rotated views are fitted without cropping.
live_rotation.landscape_controls: Scissors above Record while idle; Mark above Record and Pause/Resume below during capture.
live_rotation.manual_layout_review: App-owned landscape view rendered and visually inspected; no external-app UI interaction.

v5_playback.user_report: User confirmed playback was working again.
v5_playback.fresh_check: A read-only copy of the active five-take project was opened in isolated test storage. Earlier takes were sought, then Play was invoked for V5.
v5_playback.scope: Frozen-frame fault was not reproduced after restarting the app; no speculative decoder behavior changes were made. Decode failures now produce a diagnostic warning.

screen_light.brightness: Full window brightness, restored on toggle off, rear-only view or camera suspend. No global brightness setting changed.
screen_light.shape: Rounded inner opening clipped to the video bounds; bars outside the video are opaque white.
screen_light.resize: Drag the white border inward or outward; thickness is retained.

capture_controls.hardware_torch: Rear LED enabled only when the selected camera reports FLASH_INFO_AVAILABLE; front uses screen light.
capture_controls.picture_in_picture: First layout opens inset. Camera-arrow control swaps main/inset sources. Drag body to move; edges resize axes independently; corners resize both. Gestures work with torch on and during one uninterrupted recording.
verified: No standalone flash hit target; torch toggled through the existing Recording settings menu in portrait and landscape.
Portrait and landscape screen-light transparency, rounded corners, opaque bars, resizing and brightness restoration
Rear hardware torch request and front hardware flash off
Portrait and landscape inset swapping, movement and free-aspect resizing with screen torch enabled during recording
Encoded synthetic pixels match resized bounds and swapped inputs
All composition layouts and swaps at 0/90/180/270 degrees
capture_controls.screenshots: App-owned camera bitmaps and overlay renders only.
capture_controls.torch_access: Recording settings only; the extra standalone flash button and glyph were removed.
capture_controls.recording_marks: Vertical Mark on the right and Pause/Resume on the left in portrait; Mark above Record and Pause/Resume below in landscape. Marks survive saving and follow source edits.
capture_controls.round_picture_in_picture: Circular dual-camera inset moves, resizes and swaps while recording; a circle is retained in both display orientations. Masked corners and camera swaps verified in encoded pixels at all four metadata rotations.

multitrack.copy_paste: Selection Copy exposes repeatable Paste · Inserts time. Copies retain independent effects, source ranges and recording marks.
multitrack.move: Higher video tracks appear above lower ones. Dragging updates timing and lane live, with one undo step on Done or restoration on Cancel. Stacked copies select independently.
multitrack.layers: Add media offers Insert video, Add video layer and Add audio. Layer imports preserve existing timeline positions. Overlapping video exposes Placement · default.
multitrack.audio_import: Reference-style Add audio sheet opens the system audio picker; a copied local file becomes an independent sound layer at the requested playhead, with waveform, Move and Volume.
